cardSkillDesc: During combat, Special Offensive: Light Jaeger will provide continual fire support.
desc: The "Special Offensive" unit is a covert combat force secretly deployed by High Ambitions Corp. Modeled after the Defense Force's special operations units in terms of structure, training systems, and combat gear, they're tasked with carrying out high-risk, classified missions that conventional armed forces can't touch.
name: Special Offensive - Light Jaeger
